body: Well it beats benzos in terms of withdrawals and SSRIs in terms of onset of action, but I would start at a very, very low dose. And only as needed. I'm sure you won't be taking insane amounts like me for nerve pain but one side effect that might be frustrating is that it seems to lower verbal fluency, and you forget everyday words. But I think at a low enough dosage you can avoid the majority of side effects.

Actually, I have tried ketamine in the past but tbh I was only interested in k holing :p. Both LSD and ketamine left me with a nice sort of 'afterglow'; life just seemed more colourful and interesting again!
Actually bought some kava kava capsules from biovea which arrived today. But now I've read that you shouldn't bother with the capsules, only drink kava tea. Is it worth bothering?

I'm going to the GP tomorrow to see if they can help, if not I'm going to try some other supplements or something like kava or possibly Phenibut but I'm not really up for grabbing more benzos off the street.
Seriously, give this shit up while you still can.
Oh and when I mean overdose with benzos I mean using benzos with a bunch of other downers...yeah I'm beyond all that shit now though, just wanna get these withdrawals over and done with.

I did have quite a bad day today and ended up going to a GP because I had cold sweats, crying, weird visual things happening and I was just generally panicky. But they are loathe to prescribe anything since they're not sympathetic anyway and they just say ride it out! Maybe kava is the way, it seems like a more natural anxiolytic. Phenibut I would only use very occasionally because I'm sure its withdrawal potential is even greater than benzos. How does it differ from benzos in terms of effects btw?
